_comment: The generation agent's environment. Read config/index.mjs for why every credential here is BLANK and where the real values come from: this repository is public, so a plaintext credential committed here would be a published credential. A JSON credential file bind-mounted READ-ONLY at /run/secrets/league-sandbox-postgres.json fills them in at load, overridable by LEAGUE_SANDBOX_CREDENTIAL_FILE. A file rather than environment variables, because a container env value is readable from docker inspect and because a thread-config profile has no env field to deliver one with.
